I have a small maize plot, and here in Ruvuma I try to manage it carefully because cash is limited. Since I went to school a bit and maize is important for my household, I will use some improved seed and a small amount of chemical fertilizer, but not too much because this plot is only 0.10 hectare and I am intercropping it. I can also add some manure from home, and I will rely mostly on family work rather than paying many laborers.
